title: "Add Configurable Timeout for Shell Command Execution"
body:
**Bug Description**
Would like to be able to configure timeout on shell commands. Got a make command that needs more than two minutes to run tests

**Environment Info**

- Terminal: tmux
- Version: 0.2.107
